featureCards.title: Check whether projects are visible on the ground.
featureCards.description: Use satellite-observed renewable assets as the reality layer, not just a background map.

featureCards.title: Measure where public project claims diverge from observed infrastructure.
featureCards.description: Treat delays, downsizing, and absent build-out as first-class analytic outputs.

featureCards.description: Score infrastructure context and corridor relevance without pretending to run grid dispatch.

countrySummaries.name: Indonesia
countrySummaries.description: Primary source-side geography with strong regional relevance to cross-border electricity trade.
countrySummaries.keySignal: Best large-scale source-side anchor for Singapore-facing corridor analysis.

countrySummaries.name: Philippines
countrySummaries.description: Best public project metadata environment for validating claimed versus observed progress.
countrySummaries.keySignal: Strongest metadata backbone for a defensible MVP.

countrySummaries.name: Vietnam
countrySummaries.description: High renewable activity with useful pipeline reality-check value, but more fragmented public documentation.
countrySummaries.keySignal: Strong utility-scale comparison case with visible build-out clusters.

countrySummaries.name: Malaysia
countrySummaries.description: Source-side geography plus corridor context, especially when Sarawak is treated distinctly.
countrySummaries.keySignal: Important bridge between domestic build-out and regional corridor framing.

countrySummaries.name: Singapore
countrySummaries.description: Regional demand and import anchor rather than a main utility-scale source-side geography.
countrySummaries.keySignal: Best modeled as the regional sink node that makes corridor relevance legible.

caseStudies.title: Indonesia as the main source-side anchor
caseStudies.label: observed_smaller_than_claimed
caseStudies.summary: A cluster that appears real on the ground, but the observed footprint suggests slower realized build-out than the public headline implies.
caseStudies.whyItMatters: Useful for showing that the project is not anti-renewables; it is pro-verification.

caseStudies.title: The Philippines as the metadata proving ground
caseStudies.label: observed_on_schedule
caseStudies.summary: A cleaner case where public metadata and observed timing align well enough to serve as a validation benchmark.
caseStudies.whyItMatters: Supports the credibility of the broader matching workflow.

caseStudies.title: Sarawak as corridor logic, not just country coverage
caseStudies.label: built_and_corridor_ready
caseStudies.summary: A case where build-out and regional corridor framing can be shown in the same evidence thread.
caseStudies.whyItMatters: Helps distinguish this from a flat country-by-country map exercise.
